record.question: Since a contract is concluded by the mere acceptance of an offer, the terms of the intended or proposed agreement must be indicated with sufficient definiteness in the offer itself. The terms of the offer must therefore be definite and certain. Which of the following cases held that the proposal must be sufficiently definite to permit the conclusion of the contract by mere acceptance?
options: Coffee Board Bangalore v. Janab Dada Haji Ibrahim Halari
Gorakh Nand Yadav v. District Magistrate, Gorakhpur
Sanwarmal Goenka v. Soumyendra Chandra Gooptu
Nandganj Sihori Sugar Co. Ltd. v. Badri Nath Dixit
